مقدمة

This document out lists the إجراء الاختبار
P1، والتي يجب أن يتم كل ستة أشهر كما 
 أشير إليه بواسطة M6 في شريط العنوان أعلاه.

This document tell how to check & schedule 
 maintenance fire fighting program in oil Mazot (20,000-2000-tons) & Solar 
 tank(1000-m) fire fighting system test. for oil and solar tank .out 
 of door. Fire fighting system. the system have foam tank (1500 gallon) 
 capacity, control unit (FCI), water control valve, mixer water and foam, 
 thermal sensors, 0.5 inch nozzle and manual switch.

Note1. (Test Fire Fighting System on oil and 
 solar tanks which is used foam and water by 3% and 97% as mixed ratio 
 respectively in mixing line inside tank to make isolating material to 
 separate between fir and oil or solar )
ملاحظة2: all thermal sensors inside tank

The first draft prepared by eng. Moustfa Awadi, tested by 
eng. Adel Shawki & Safety eng. Ashraf Gaber at 21 June 2003, 
 revised by quality control eng. i & c Abdl Menem Al Emam & EDEPCO 
 Safety eng. Medhat Kater, approved by eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy sector head of Talkha 
 Power station, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa AL Lethy EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
فئة السلامة المناسبة,

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety 
 and healthy equipments safety helmet, safety shoes
. Etc

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Close valves on foam tanks to check system by water only with foam .
Pull the manual then the system activated by control panel.
يتم رش الماء حول الخزان ويعمل بوق الفلاش.
Clean the water spray around tank if not passing water

sections.text:
ملحوظة:
Testing of fire attend out of tank only to keep system inside tank with treble
.

Return 
system to service
Return the manual riles to it is position (OFF)
Make rest from panel FCI for flasher horn .
Return the control valve on water pipe in close position .
Open the isolating valve on water pipe slowly .
Open the isolating valve on foam tank.
